units.*_s: seconds of wall time inside the container (perf_counter), models resident, cold start excluded
units.*_m / *_cm / *_mm: estimated: floor plane + an assumed 1.6 m camera height; never measured
units.reprojection_px_at_504_crop: pixels of the 504 px crop (x 720/504 = 1.43 for source pixels of the 1280x720 videos; 480/504 for the 640x480 factory clip)
units.before / after (BA): before = the same objective with the coarse cameras and the anchor depth frozen (only the track points move); after = the joint solve
units.tilt_repeatability: frames A = X4's selection, frames B = the same selector with A's frames +-5 excluded; fine plane tilt |A - B|
units.*_gib / peak_gb: GiB, whole device (nvidia-smi, incl. vLLM), per stage window; over_90 flags > 90 %

matcher.extractor: ALIKED aliked-n16, 2048 keypoints, threshold 0.05, on the 504 px crop

hardware: 1 x A100-80GB (Modal), vLLM Qwen3-VL-8B on the same card at 30 %
